title: Supply Chain & Logistics Optimization
description: Advancing operations research and mathematical optimization for complex logistics and supply chain systems, including vehicle routing, scheduling, facility location, network design, inventory management, transportation planning, and integrated supply chain decision-making.
featured_venues: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies (TRC)
Journal of the Operational Research Society (JORS)

title: AI & Data-Driven Supply Chain Intelligence
description: Developing artificial intelligence and data-driven methods for intelligent supply chain decision-making, including machine learning, forecasting, predictive-prescriptive analytics, learning-enhanced optimization, and AI-supported planning and operations.

title: Optimization & Decision Analytics for Complex Systems
description: Developing optimization and decision-analytics approaches for complex systems beyond logistics and supply chains, with applications in energy, healthcare, finance and business, public services, urban systems, hospitality, and digital operations.
featured_venues: Journal of the Operational Research Society (JORS)
